title: CASA: Content-Acoustic Speaking Assessment with Speech Encoder and Large Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.13101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on automatic speaking assessment (ASA) has increasingly adopted multimodal speech large language models to assess learners' speaking performance. However, existing studies provide limited analysis of how acoustic and content information contribute to predictions and how stable the resulting performance is. We propose CASA, a simpler architecture combining Whisper-medium and Qwen3.5-2B that achieves state-of-the-art performance while providing a more interpretable separation between speech delivery and content.   On the Speak & Improve Corpus 2025, CASA achieves a root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.358, improving on the previous best RMSE while using approximately half the estimated inference parameters. The general-purpose architecture is designed for adaptation to other ASA corpora without structural changes and relies on three handcrafted fluency features. translated_title: CASA：基于语音编码器与大型语言模型的内容-语音口语评估
translated_abstract: 自动口语评估（ASA）研究日益采用多模态语音大型语言模型来评估学习者的口语表现。然而，现有研究对声学信息和内容信息如何贡献于预测以及所产生性能的稳定性分析有限。我们提出CASA，一种更简单的架构，结合了Whisper-medium和Qwen3.5-2B，在实现最先进性能的同时，提供了语音表达和内容之间更可解释的分离。在Speak & Improve Corpus 2025上，CASA实现了0.358的均方根误差（RMSE），在改进先前最佳RMSE的同时，使用的推理参数估计约为其一半。该通用架构旨在无需结构更改即可适应其他ASA语料库，并依赖三个手工设计的流利度特征。通过消融研究和重复实验，我们分析了单个和组合特征的影响。
tldr: CASA通过结合Whisper-medium和Qwen3.5-2B，在口语评估中实现了最先进的性能（RMSE为0.358），同时以约一半的推理参数提供了对声学和内容贡献的更可解释分离，并设计了无需结构更改即可适应其他语料库的通用架构。
en_tdlr: CASA achieves state-of-the-art speaking assessment performance (RMSE 0.358) by combining Whisper-medium and Qwen3.5-2B, with roughly half the inference parameters and a more interpretable separation of acoustic and content contributions, designed for easy adaptation to other corpora.
